Maison.title: Maison Soleil: a digital foundation worthy of the place
Maison.lead: Andrew Gee has run Maison Soleil in the Seychelles since 2009 — a boutique retreat with real soul, art, and an exceptional location. The property deserved a digital presence at the same level.
story: For years, the retreat relied on an outdated website and heavy dependence on third-party booking platforms. The brand experience online did not match the standard of the place itself.
We rebuilt the digital foundation: a professional website, a clear direct inquiry and booking path, and practical automation so interest can turn into real guest conversations.
In this project, that also meant reducing platform dependence and putting more of the guest relationship back in the owner’s hands — a specific outcome for this brief, not the only kind of work I do.
Maison.shift: A premium digital system that reflects the level of Maison Soleil — and gives guests a clear way to inquire and book direct.
